title: Studio 菜单（M2）：类型顺序和「常用 / 高级」写成一张表，用测试钉住注册表和 ADR
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

Part of #36890. Ruling: #37192, comment 7151834490. Proposal: 7151777190 §3.4. The maintainer asked for this to be dispatched first.

## What

- **One new file:** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioMenuPlacement.ts`. It holds one ordered list of `{ type, tier: 'common' | 'advanced' }`, in the ruled order:
  - common: object · app, page, dashboard, report · flow · permission · agent, tool, skill
  - every other menu type: advanced, in the proposal's order. This includes picklist (选项列表) and email template.
  - The list holds order and tier only. The group stays the served `domain`.
- **Registry pin:** every type in `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` that the directory can list has exactly one row, and every row names a registered type.
- **ADR pin:** the order and tier columns of ADR-0084's table (the M1 card) equal the list, modelled on `studioAddressTable.test.ts`.
  - If M1 has not merged yet, either land this pin together with M1, or add it in a follow-up commit once M1 is in.
- The new files are not wired into anything yet; M3 wires them.

## Done when

- The table and both pins land.
- An ablation shows the pins go red when a row is removed, misordered, or names an unknown type.

## Notes

- Shares no file with the open Studio PRs #37168, #37169, #37166 and #37089, so it can run now.
- Size S. `Clause-②: no`. `Metadata-protocol: none`.
